title: 环境音效与氛围音不足
description: 游戏缺少环境音、背景音和氛围音效，导致世界缺乏沉浸感，如缺少飞船吱嘎声等。
evidence: only bad thing is the music imo, it's really good but the game needs more, ambient sounds and general background noises
The sound design is uninteresting. you never hear the ship creaking and threatening to break apart. You hear nothing.
theres long periods with none, which would be fine if we had louder or more living world souds or ambiet noise

evidence_items.quote: The sound design is uninteresting. you never hear the ship creaking and threatening to break apart. You hear nothing.
evidence_items.description: 音效设计无趣，缺乏飞船吱嘎声等氛围音
evidence_items.quote_zh: 音效设计毫无趣味。你永远听不到飞船吱嘎作响、仿佛要散架的声音。你什么都听不到。

evidence_items.quote: The soundscape is still very bland
